name: temelash-card
description: Temelash Card: digital stamp-card loyalty for businesses in Ethiopia

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @temelash/api -w @temelash/customer -w @temelash/staff -w @temelash/owner -w @temelash/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
